executive_summary: Seventh consecutive week of 0% win rate with only 1 trade taken (a loss). The bot is now in a failure mode where raised min_score filters out almost all setups, but the rare setup that passes still loses. Cumulative loss is ~₹-12,975 over 14 trades across 7 weeks with ZERO wins. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is fundamentally broken in current market conditions and must be replaced or completely overhauled — no parameter adjustment will fix a 0/14 track record.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below 70% target. No progress in 7 weeks.
regime_assessment: Regime detection identifies trending_down correctly (5 of 7 days), but the strategy does not adapt its behavior to regime. Supply & Demand zones are counter-trend by nature (buying at demand in a downtrend), which explains the persistent losses. The regime signal is accurate but completely unused.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol-level data available to make targeted removals. The problem is strategy-level, not symbol-level.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: Cannot identify winning symbols — zero wins across all symbols in 7 weeks.

dow_pattern: Insufficient trade volume to identify day-of-week patterns. Only 1 trade this week (Monday loss). The real pattern is that the bot barely trades at all.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: LOWERING min_score to generate more trades for data collection. Lowering RR ratio to increase probability of hitting target. However, these changes are secondary to the structural recommendations below — parameters cannot fix a fundamentally misaligned strategy.

structural_recommendations.change: HALT Supply & Demand Zone strategy entirely. Replace with a trend-following strategy (e.g., momentum breakouts, moving average crossovers, or VWAP trend continuation) that aligns WITH the detected regime rather than fading it.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Eliminates the core problem of counter-trend entries in trending markets. Even a basic trend-following approach should achieve 35-45% win rate with proper RR, versus current 0%.

structural_recommendations.change: Add regime-strategy mapping: Only allow Supply & Demand zones in 'ranging' regimes. In trending_down, only allow short-biased or trend-following strategies. In trending_up, only allow long-biased strategies.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents systematic counter-trend losses. Should reduce losing trades by 60-80% based on the observation that most losses occurred during trending regimes.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a paper-trading / simulation mode that runs parallel strategies and only activates the one with positive expectancy over a 2-week lookback. The current approach of running a single failing strategy for 7+ weeks is destroying capital.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Enables strategy switching based on evidence rather than waiting for weekly manual review. Could reduce drawdown periods from 7+ weeks to 2-3 weeks.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a circuit breaker: if cumulative P&L drops below -₹10,000 or win rate is 0% for 3 consecutive weeks, automatically halt live trading and switch to paper mode until a strategy demonstrates >40% win rate over 20+ simulated trades.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Caps maximum capital loss and prevents further bleeding. Would have saved ~₹5,000-7,000 if implemented 4 weeks ago.

structural_recommendations.change: If retaining Supply & Demand zones at all, add a trend-alignment filter: only trade demand zones when price is above 20 EMA (or supply zones when below). Never take counter-trend zone trades.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Filters out the highest-probability losers. Based on 7 weeks of data, likely eliminates 80%+ of the losing setups that were taken.

primary_strategy_next_week: Trend-Following Momentum (replace Supply & Demand Zones entirely)
